description: Source code for Azure-based text completion handling in a language model framework, including synchronous and asynchronous methods, streaming support, environment validation, and external API interactions.

classes.name: AzureTextCompletion
classes.description: A class providing methods for Azure-based text completion, including validation, synchronous and asynchronous completion, streaming, and environment setup.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares headers for environment validation using API key or Azure AD token.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Performs a text completion request, supporting streaming, async, and standard modes, with detailed logging and error handling.

methods.name: acompletion
methods.description: Asynchronous version of completion, using async Azure OpenAI client.

methods.name: streaming
methods.description: Performs a streaming text completion synchronously, returning a CustomStreamWrapper.

methods.name: async_streaming
methods.description: Performs a streaming text completion asynchronously, returning a CustomStreamWrapper.
